V99.title: Density doubling, double-circulants, and new sphere packings
V99.publication: Transactions of the American Mathematical Society 351 (1999), 271–283
V99.locator: Section 4, the table of log2(delta(E_n)) for n=57,...,63
V99.role: Historical same-dimensional numerical comparison: Elkies's sections E_n, reported by Vardy. These are not being attributed to Vardy as their constructor.
V99.limitation: The table gives lower bounds with ellipses, not exact section determinants or a current record survey. No percentage improvement over the actual Elkies lattices is certified from those truncated numbers.

N98.title: Some cyclo-quaternionic lattices
N98.locator: The Ne64 lattice; see the catalogue's REFERENCES and GRAM entries
N98.role: Construction of the 64D parent Ne64. Used with N99 for its minimum theorem, not as a published 59D or 65D comparison result.

N99.title: Construction and investigation of lattices with matrix groups
N99.locator: The minimum-norm reference identified in the Ne64 catalogue's REFERENCES entry
N99.role: Published minimum-12 input for Ne64. The resulting center density in dimension 64 is 3^16. No same-dimensional 59D or 65D result is attributed to this paper.

N12.title: An even unimodular 72-dimensional lattice of minimum 8
N12.publication: Journal für die reine und angewandte Mathematik 673 (2012), 237–247; preprint 2010
N12.locator: Section 2 constructs Gamma72; Section 4 proves minimum 8; center density in dimension 72 is 2^36
N12.role: Published 72D parent and its minimum theorem. Our selected sections and antipode clusters in dimensions 58–71 are computations in this repository, not numerical records quoted from this paper.

S19.title: Mordell–Weil Lattices, chapter Ranks and Sphere Packings
S19.publication: Springer (2019), chapter 13; 56D construction cited at p. 400 by the Nebe–Sloane catalogue
S19.locator: 56D input, delta=5^28/(2^28*29^4); catalogue row 56 cites M. Schütt, MW19 p. 400
S19.role: Published 56D density input for our derived torus-layer and product bounds. The 57D value 151706.083320 is calculated here and must not be attributed to this chapter.
S19.limitation: The earlier audit recorded the exact 56D input from Cohn's table and the catalogue attribution; the book's full text was not available in the inspected publisher preview.

CS96.authors: J. H. Conway and N. J. A. Sloane
CS96.title: The Antipode Construction for Sphere Packings
CS96.role: The construction method. This paper's examples do not supply the 59D or 65–71D numerical comparison values used here.
